Question 4
?

The velocity v of a particle P at time t is given by v(t)=⟨t2,1,3t⟩. Find the tangential component of acceleration at time t.

a
2tt4+9t2+1
b
t(2t2+9)t4+9t2+1
c
tt2+3
d
t2+3t4+9t2+1
e
2t+1t2+3
